message:

import glob,os,subprocess,time,json
files=sorted(glob.glob('src-vul/openssl/fuzz/corpora/server/*'), key=os.path.getsize, reverse=True)[:20]
for f in files:
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','/workspace/submit.sh',f,'/workspace/candidate_trace.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    print(os.path.basename(f), 'rc', r.returncode)
    print(r.stdout.splitlines()[-1] if r.stdout else '')
    time.sleep(3)
PY` executed with exit code 0.
